Metadata.Goal: 构建 canonical Tiptap adapter、Presentation compiler 和可复用 Halfcode Vue 文档编辑器。
Metadata.Description: 补齐传统语义的 Tiptap 双向适配，建立 stable-id 工具计划和单 draft owner 的响应式编辑器 capsule。

TaskSpace.name: build-reusable-halfcode-document-editor
TaskSpace.Description: 先闭合 canonical adapter，再建立 data-only compiler，随后装配 editor capsule 并做真实浏览器验证。

Task.name: 冻结传统语义 Tiptap schema 与 round-trip 红测

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests 覆盖所有新增 nodes/marks/attrs、persistent identity、absent alignment 与 invalid values
Hard-break 保持 inline atom，task-list 保持独立 node family

Task.name: 扩展唯一 extension registry 与 projection parser

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Canonical GetPut/PutGet 对传统语义无损且使用 G2 color validation
不创建 parallel schema、registry 或 HTML adapter

Task.name: 扩展 transaction normalizer 与 draft lifecycle 覆盖

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Paste、IME、undo/redo、copy/move 与 attributes/inline edits 产生 canonical revision-free interaction
Matching/replacement/conflict 保持既有单 EditorState lifecycle 语义

Task.name: 定义并校验 serializable Presentation 与 ToolbarPlan

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Types/validator 拒绝 duplicate、unknown、accessor、unsafe、closure 和 renderer objects
Plan deep frozen、递归可序列化且 diagnostics deterministic

Task.name: 实现 compiler、canonical command registry 与 restricted facade

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Compiler 遵守 output = fn(runtime,input,config) 且 runtime 只承载 registry/capability references
Presenter override 不能替换 canonical command；host tool 需 distinct id + grant

Task.name: 实现单 draft owner editor factory 与 Vue surface

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Host authoring/registry/effects 位于 runtime，input 不携 revision authority
Mount/update/unmount、composition、history 与 reproject 无第二 draft store

Task.name: 实现 responsive toolbar 与 enhanced code Presenter

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Grouped/contextual/overflow tools 全部可达并支持 focus、keyboard、tooltip
Highlight/fold/copy/line numbers/theme 仅本地；clipboard/highlighter 经注入 effect

Task.name: 运行 package、laws、jsdom 与真实浏览器宽窄验证

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Contract/logic/tiptap tests、typecheck、root ESM/CJS、diff check 全绿
真实浏览器验证 overflow reachability/context/focus/tooltip/no horizontal-scroll hiding

Task.name: 更新分层用法、Presentation 和 public API 文档

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 文档给出三档用法、runtime/input/config、authority 和 enhanced code boundary
Public root 暴露稳定 API，internals 与 Workbench 实现不泄漏
